reason: B is the stronger proposal because minor Y alloying invokes the well-established reactive-element effect and directly targets oxide-scale adhesion and spallation, whereas A incorrectly characterizes already-oxidized Y2O3 as an oxygen scavenger and assumes uniform nanoscale dispersion and efficacy above 1200 °C. B still needs evidence and should specify an alumina- or chromia-forming HEA and avoid the unsupported 15–25% lifetime estimate.
